request: A proposed AI use case, built or bought, arriving from a product team or a procurement request.
record: The structured use-case record: intended purpose, out-of-scope uses, users and affected persons, decision authority, success metrics, error appetite, data sources and jurisdictions.
screen: The prohibited-practice screen runs first; then the system is placed on the AI Act ladder, including the Art. 6(3) filter and its profiling override.
tier: A versioned tier rule computes the internal tier from declared profile fields such as autonomy, decision impact, exposure, reversibility and data class.
gates: The tier selects the assessments, eval categories and thresholds, approvers and review cadence the system must clear.
registry: The intake record becomes the registry entry; deployment refuses any system without one.
blocked: A use case that hits the prohibited-practice screen is blocked at intake and never tiered.
